query: Under what circumstances can one be fined for sending intimidating text communications?
reference_answer:
Threatening Text Messages:
Sending threatening text messages can result in imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under Section 506 of the IPC and the Information Technology Act, 2000.
answer: One can be fined for sending intimidating text communications if they are deemed to threaten someone's safety or well-being under laws against harassment and intimidation. [System]
